responsibility: Implements 32-bit MIPS ABI lowering for FnAbi, tracking running stack/register offsets so aggregate arguments are coerced into i32 chunks with required padding and aggregate returns consume an implicit indirect-result pointer slot.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/mips.rs`, this file is specifically about 32-bit MIPS function ABI layout, tracking argument/return offsets, padding, and indirect aggregate returns instead of naming and validating inline-assembly registers.
